# Auto-generated by Phase Diagram Agent LAMMPS runtime
units metal
dimension 3
boundary p p p
atom_style atomic

variable initTemp equal 300
variable targetTemp equal 700
variable runSteps equal 5000
variable boxSize equal 4

lattice fcc 4.05
region box block 0 4 0 4 0 4
create_box 1 box
create_atoms 1 box
mass 1 26.9815

pair_style eam/alloy
pair_coeff * * /opt/homebrew/share/lammps/potentials/Al_zhou.eam.alloy Al

neighbor 2.0 bin
neigh_modify delay 10 check yes
timestep 0.001
velocity all create 300 4928459 mom yes rot yes dist gaussian
thermo 100
thermo_style custom step temp pe ke etotal press
dump 1 all custom 100 dump.atom id type x y z

fix 1 all nvt temp 700 700 0.1
run 5000
